# 130 — Omni reference calculus: coinductive type safety

## Task

Show that a well-typed closed program in a well-typed store satisfies the coinductive omni-big-step judgment with a type-preserving postcondition.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `coomnibig_soundness_result`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: TLC.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.
=== Task.v ===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import STLC_Ref_Soundness_Common.

Implicit Types Y : phi.

Implicit Types P : conf->Prop.

CoInductive coomnibig : conf -> (conf->Prop) -> Prop :=
  | coomnibig_val : forall c P,
      value (fst c) ->
      P c ->
      coomnibig c P
  | coomnibig_beta : forall mu t1 t2 P,
      sto_ok mu ->
      term (trm_abs t1) ->
      value t2 ->
      coomnibig (t1 ^^ t2, mu) P ->
      coomnibig (trm_app (trm_abs t1) t2, mu) P
  | coomnibig_rand : forall mu n P,
      (forall m, 0 <= m < max n 1 -> P ((trm_int m), mu)) ->
      coomnibig (trm_rand (trm_int n), mu) P
  | coomnibig_ref : forall mu t1 P,
      sto_ok mu ->
      value t1 ->
      (forall l, l # mu ->
        P (trm_loc l, (mu & l ~ t1))) ->
      coomnibig (trm_ref t1, mu) P
  | coomnibig_get : forall mu l t P,
      sto_ok mu ->
      binds l t mu ->
      P (t, mu) ->
      coomnibig (trm_get (trm_loc l), mu) P
  | coomnibig_set : forall mu l t2 P,
      sto_ok mu ->
      value t2 ->
      P (trm_unit, mu & l ~ t2) ->
      coomnibig (trm_set (trm_loc l) t2, mu) P

  | coomnibig_app_1 : forall mu t1 t2 P1 P,
      ~ value t1 ->
      coomnibig (t1, mu) P1 ->
      (forall t1' mu', P1 (t1',mu') -> coomnibig (trm_app t1' t2, mu') P) ->
      coomnibig (trm_app t1 t2, mu) P
  | coomnibig_app_2 : forall mu t1 t2 P1 P,
      value t1 ->
      ~ value t2 ->
      coomnibig (t2, mu) P1 ->
      (forall t2' mu', P1 (t2',mu') -> coomnibig (trm_app t1 t2', mu') P) ->
      coomnibig (trm_app t1 t2, mu) P
  | coomnibig_ref_1 : forall mu t1 P1 P,
      ~ value t1 ->
      coomnibig (t1, mu) P1 ->
      (forall t1' mu', P1 (t1',mu') -> coomnibig (trm_ref t1', mu') P) ->
      coomnibig (trm_ref t1, mu) P
  | coomnibig_get_1 : forall mu t1 P1 P,
      coomnibig (t1, mu) P1 ->
      (forall t1' mu', P1 (t1',mu') -> coomnibig (trm_get t1', mu') P) ->
      coomnibig (trm_get t1, mu) P
  | coomnibig_set_1 : forall mu t1 t2 P1 P,
      ~ value t1 ->
      coomnibig (t1, mu) P1 ->
      (forall t1' mu', P1 (t1',mu') -> coomnibig (trm_set t1' t2, mu') P) ->
      coomnibig (trm_set t1 t2, mu) P
  | coomnibig_set_2 : forall mu t1 t2 P1 P,
      value t1 ->
      ~ value t2 ->
      coomnibig (t2, mu) P1 ->
      (forall t2' mu', P1 (t2',mu') -> coomnibig (trm_set t1 t2', mu') P) ->
      coomnibig (trm_set t1 t2, mu) P
  | coomnibig_rand_1 : forall mu t1 P1 P,
      ~ value t1 ->
      coomnibig (t1, mu) P1 ->
      (forall t1' mu', P1 (t1',mu') -> coomnibig (trm_rand t1', mu') P) ->
      coomnibig (trm_rand t1, mu) P.

Definition post (Y:phi) (T:typ) : conf->Prop :=
  fun '(t,mu) =>
    exists Y', extends Y Y'
             /\ Y' |== mu
             /\ value t
             /\ empty ! Y' |= t ~: T.

Definition coomnibig_soundness := forall mu t Y T,
  Y |== mu ->
  empty ! Y |= t ~: T ->
  coomnibig (t,mu) (post Y T).

Definition himpl (H1 H2:conf->Prop) : Prop :=
  forall h, H1 h -> H2 h.

Notation "H1 ==> H2" := (himpl H1 H2) (at level 55).

Theorem coomnibig_soundness_result : coomnibig_soundness.
=== Makefile ===
# A dependency directory is named after its Rocq library (for example, Metalib).
LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)
LIBRARY_FLAGS := $(foreach lib,$(LIBRARIES),-R $(lib) $(notdir $(lib)))

.PHONY: all clean
all: Makefile.coq
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq

Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile
	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

clean:
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq clean

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.

From TLC Require Export LibLN LibNat.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_var   : var -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_ref   : typ -> typ
  | typ_int   : typ
  | typ_unit  : typ.

Definition loc := var.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_bvar : nat -> trm
  | trm_fvar : var -> trm
  | trm_abs  : trm -> trm
  | trm_app  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_unit : trm
  | trm_int : nat -> trm
  | trm_loc : loc -> trm
  | trm_ref : trm -> trm
  | trm_get : trm -> trm
  | trm_set : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_rand : trm -> trm.

Fixpoint open_rec (k : nat) (u : trm) (t : trm) {struct t} : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_bvar i    => If k = i then u else (trm_bvar i)
  | trm_fvar x    => trm_fvar x
  | trm_abs t1    => trm_abs (open_rec (S k) u t1)
  | trm_app t1 t2 => trm_app (open_rec k u t1) (open_rec k u t2)
  | trm_unit      => trm_unit
  | trm_int n     => trm_int n
  | trm_loc l     => trm_loc l
  | trm_ref t1    => trm_ref (open_rec k u t1)
  | trm_get t1    => trm_get (open_rec k u t1)
  | trm_set t1 t2 => trm_set (open_rec k u t1) (open_rec k u t2)
  | trm_rand t1   => trm_rand (open_rec k u t1)
  end.

Definition open t u := open_rec 0 u t.

Notation "{ k ~> u } t" := (open_rec k u t) (at level 67).

Notation "t ^^ u" := (open t u) (at level 67).

Notation "t ^ x" := (open t (trm_fvar x)).

Inductive term : trm -> Prop :=
  | term_var : forall x,
      term (trm_fvar x)
  | term_abs : forall L t1,
      (forall x, x \notin L -> term (t1 ^ x)) ->
      term (trm_abs t1)
  | term_app : forall t1 t2,
      term t1 -> term t2 -> term (trm_app t1 t2)
  | term_trm_unit :
      term trm_unit
  | term_int : forall n,
      term (trm_int n)
  | term_loc : forall l,
      term (trm_loc l)
  | term_ref : forall t1,
      term t1 ->
      term (trm_ref t1)
  | term_get : forall t1,
      term t1 ->
      term (trm_get t1)
  | term_set : forall t1 t2,
      term t1 ->
      term t2 ->
      term (trm_set t1 t2)
  | term_rand : forall t1,
      term t1 ->
      term (trm_rand t1).

Definition sto := LibEnv.env trm.

Definition phi := LibEnv.env typ.

Inductive sto_ok : sto -> Prop :=
  | sto_ok_empty : sto_ok empty
  | sto_ok_push : forall mu l t,
      sto_ok mu -> term t ->
      sto_ok (mu & l ~ t).

Definition env := LibEnv.env typ.

Reserved Notation "E ! Y |= t ~: T" (at level 69).

Inductive typing : env -> phi -> trm -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_var : forall E Y x T,
      ok E ->
      binds x T E ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_fvar x) ~: T
  | typing_abs : forall L E Y U T t1,
      (forall x, x \notin L -> (E & x ~ U) ! Y  |= t1 ^ x ~: T) ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_abs t1) ~: (typ_arrow U T)
  | typing_app : forall T1 T2 E Y t1 t2,
      E ! Y |= t1 ~: (typ_arrow T1 T2) -> E ! Y  |= t2 ~: T1 ->
      E ! Y  |= (trm_app t1 t2) ~: T2
  | typing_unit : forall E Y,
      ok E ->
      E ! Y |= trm_unit ~: typ_unit
  | typing_int : forall E Y n,
      ok E ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_int n) ~: typ_int
  | typing_loc : forall E Y l T,
      ok E ->
      binds l T Y ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_loc l) ~: (typ_ref T)
  | typing_ref : forall E Y t1 T,
      E ! Y |= t1 ~: T ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_ref t1) ~: (typ_ref T)
  | typing_get : forall E Y t1 T,
      E ! Y |= t1 ~: (typ_ref T) ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_get t1) ~: T
  | typing_set : forall E Y t1 t2 T,
      E ! Y |= t1 ~: (typ_ref T) ->
      E ! Y |= t2 ~: T ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_set t1 t2) ~: typ_unit
  | typing_rand : forall E Y t1,
      E ! Y |= t1 ~: typ_int ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_rand t1) ~: typ_int

where "E ! Y |= t ~: T" := (typing E Y t T).

Inductive value : trm -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1,
      term (trm_abs t1) ->
      value (trm_abs t1)
  | value_unit :
      value trm_unit
  | value_int : forall n,
      value (trm_int n)
  | value_loc : forall l,
      value (trm_loc l).

Definition sto_typing Y mu :=
     sto_ok mu
  /\ (forall l, l # mu -> l # Y)
  /\ (forall l T, binds l T Y ->
        exists t, value t
               /\ binds l t mu
               /\ empty ! Y |= t ~: T).

Notation "Y |== mu" := (sto_typing Y mu) (at level 68).

Definition conf := (trm * sto)%type.

Inductive red : conf -> conf -> Prop :=

  | red_beta : forall mu t1 t2,
      sto_ok mu ->
      term (trm_abs t1) ->
      value t2 ->
      red (trm_app (trm_abs t1) t2, mu) (t1 ^^ t2, mu)
  | red_ref : forall mu t1 l,
      sto_ok mu ->
      value t1 ->
      l # mu ->
      red (trm_ref t1, mu) (trm_loc l, (mu & l ~ t1))
  | red_get : forall mu l t,
      sto_ok mu ->
      binds l t mu ->
      red (trm_get (trm_loc l), mu) (t, mu)
  | red_set : forall mu l t2,
      sto_ok mu ->
      value t2 ->
      red (trm_set (trm_loc l) t2, mu) (trm_unit, mu & l ~ t2)

  | red_app_1 : forall mu mu' t1 t1' t2,
      term t2 ->
      red (t1, mu) (t1', mu') ->
      red (trm_app t1 t2, mu) (trm_app t1' t2, mu')
  | red_app_2 : forall mu mu' t1 t2 t2',
      value t1 ->
      red (t2, mu) (t2', mu') ->
      red (trm_app t1 t2, mu) (trm_app t1 t2', mu')
  | red_ref_1 : forall mu mu' t1 t1',
      red (t1, mu) (t1', mu') ->
      red (trm_ref t1, mu) (trm_ref t1', mu')
  | red_get_1 : forall mu mu' t1 t1',
      red (t1, mu) (t1', mu') ->
      red (trm_get t1, mu) (trm_get t1', mu')
  | red_set_1 : forall mu mu' t1 t1' t2,
      red (t1, mu) (t1', mu') ->
      term t2 ->
      red (trm_set t1 t2, mu) (trm_set t1' t2, mu')
  | red_set_2 : forall mu mu' t1 t2 t2',
      value t1 ->
      red (t2, mu) (t2', mu') ->
      red (trm_set t1 t2, mu) (trm_set t1 t2', mu')
  | red_rand : forall mu n m,
      sto_ok mu ->
      (0 <= m < max 1 n) ->
      red (trm_rand (trm_int n), mu) ((trm_int m), mu)
  | red_rand_1 : forall mu mu' t1 t1',
      red (t1, mu) (t1', mu') ->
      red (trm_rand t1, mu) (trm_rand t1', mu').

Notation "c --> c'" := (red c c') (at level 68).

Inductive reds : conf -> conf -> Prop :=
  | reds_here : forall c,
      term (fst c) ->
      reds c c
  | reds_step : forall c1 c2 c3,
      red c1 c2 ->
      reds c2 c3 ->
      reds c1 c3.

Definition terminal_conf (c:conf) : Prop :=
  value (fst c).

Definition reducible_conf (c:conf) : Prop :=
  exists c', c --> c'.

Definition safe_conf (c:conf) : Prop :=
  forall c', reds c c' -> terminal_conf c' \/ reducible_conf c'.

Definition typed_conf (c:conf) : Prop :=
  let '(t,mu) := c in
  exists Y T,
     empty ! Y |= t ~: T
  /\ Y |== mu.

Definition soundness : Prop :=
  forall c, typed_conf c -> safe_conf c.

  | trm_set : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_rand : trm -> trm.

  match t with
  | trm_bvar i    => If k = i then u else (trm_bvar i)
  | trm_fvar x    => trm_fvar x
  | trm_abs t1    => trm_abs (open_rec (S k) u t1)
  | trm_app t1 t2 => trm_app (open_rec k u t1) (open_rec k u t2)
  | trm_unit      => trm_unit
  | trm_int n     => trm_int n
  | trm_loc l     => trm_loc l
  | trm_ref t1    => trm_ref (open_rec k u t1)
  | trm_get t1    => trm_get (open_rec k u t1)
  | trm_set t1 t2 => trm_set (open_rec k u t1) (open_rec k u t2)
  | trm_rand t1   => trm_rand (open_rec k u t1)
  end.

Notation "{ k ~> u } t" := (open_rec k u t) (at level 67).

Notation "t ^^ u" := (open t u) (at level 67).

Notation "t ^ x" := (open t (trm_fvar x)).

Inductive term : trm -> Prop :=
  | term_var : forall x,
      term (trm_fvar x)
  | term_abs : forall L t1,
      (forall x, x \notin L -> term (t1 ^ x)) ->
      term (trm_abs t1)
  | term_app : forall t1 t2,
      term t1 -> term t2 -> term (trm_app t1 t2)
  | term_trm_unit :
      term trm_unit
  | term_int : forall n,
      term (trm_int n)
  | term_loc : forall l,
      term (trm_loc l)
  | term_ref : forall t1,
      term t1 ->
      term (trm_ref t1)
  | term_get : forall t1,
      term t1 ->
      term (trm_get t1)
  | term_set : forall t1 t2,
      term t1 ->
      term t2 ->
      term (trm_set t1 t2)
  | term_rand : forall t1,
      term t1 ->
      term (trm_rand t1).

Definition phi := LibEnv.env typ.

Inductive sto_ok : sto -> Prop :=
  | sto_ok_empty : sto_ok empty

      ok E ->
      binds x T E ->

      (forall x, x \notin L -> (E & x ~ U) ! Y  |= t1 ^ x ~: T) ->

  | typing_app : forall T1 T2 E Y t1 t2,
      E ! Y |= t1 ~: (typ_arrow T1 T2) -> E ! Y  |= t2 ~: T1 ->

      ok E ->

      E ! Y |= (trm_loc l) ~: (typ_ref T)

      E ! Y |= t1 ~: T ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_ref t1) ~: (typ_ref T)
  | typing_get : forall E Y t1 T,
      E ! Y |= t1 ~: (typ_ref T) ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_get t1) ~: T
  | typing_set : forall E Y t1 t2 T,
      E ! Y |= t1 ~: (typ_ref T) ->
      E ! Y |= t2 ~: T ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_set t1 t2) ~: typ_unit
  | typing_rand : forall E Y t1,
      E ! Y |= t1 ~: typ_int ->
      E ! Y |= (trm_rand t1) ~: typ_int

where "E ! Y |= t ~: T" := (typing E Y t T).

Inductive value : trm -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1,
      term (trm_abs t1) ->
      value (trm_abs t1)
  | value_unit :
      value trm_unit
  | value_int : forall n,
      value (trm_int n)
  | value_loc : forall l,
      value (trm_loc l).

Definition sto_typing Y mu :=
     sto_ok mu
  /\ (forall l, l # mu -> l # Y)
  /\ (forall l T, binds l T Y ->
        exists t, value t
               /\ binds l t mu
               /\ empty ! Y |= t ~: T).

Notation "Y |== mu" := (sto_typing Y mu) (at level 68).

Definition conf := (trm * sto)%type.

Inductive red : conf -> conf -> Prop :=

  | red_beta : forall mu t1 t2,
      sto_ok mu ->
      term (trm_abs t1) ->
      value t2 ->
      red (trm_app (trm_abs t1) t2, mu) (t1 ^^ t2, mu)
  | red_ref : forall mu t1 l,
      sto_ok mu ->
      value t1 ->
      l # mu ->
      red (trm_ref t1, mu) (trm_loc l, (mu & l ~ t1))
  | red_get : forall mu l t,
      sto_ok mu ->
      binds l t mu ->
      red (trm_get (trm_loc l), mu) (t, mu)
  | red_set : forall mu l t2,
      sto_ok mu ->
      value t2 ->
      red (trm_set (trm_loc l) t2, mu) (trm_unit, mu & l ~ t2)

  | red_app_1 : forall mu mu' t1 t1' t2,
      term t2 ->
      red (t1, mu) (t1', mu') ->
      red (trm_app t1 t2, mu) (trm_app t1' t2, mu')
  | red_app_2 : forall mu mu' t1 t2 t2',
      value t1 ->
      red (t2, mu) (t2', mu') ->
      red (trm_app t1 t2, mu) (trm_app t1 t2', mu')
  | red_ref_1 : forall mu mu' t1 t1',
      red (t1, mu) (t1', mu') ->
      red (trm_ref t1, mu) (trm_ref t1', mu')
  | red_get_1 : forall mu mu' t1 t1',
      red (t1, mu) (t1', mu') ->
      red (trm_get t1, mu) (trm_get t1', mu')
  | red_set_1 : forall mu mu' t1 t1' t2,
      red (t1, mu) (t1', mu') ->
      term t2 ->
      red (trm_set t1 t2, mu) (trm_set t1' t2, mu')
  | red_set_2 : forall mu mu' t1 t2 t2',
      value t1 ->
      red (t2, mu) (t2', mu') ->
      red (trm_set t1 t2, mu) (trm_set t1 t2', mu')
  | red_rand : forall mu n m,
      sto_ok mu ->
      (0 <= m < max 1 n) ->
      red (trm_rand (trm_int n), mu) ((trm_int m), mu)
  | red_rand_1 : forall mu mu' t1 t1',
      red (t1, mu) (t1', mu') ->
      red (trm_rand t1, mu) (trm_rand t1', mu').

Notation "c --> c'" := (red c c') (at level 68).

Inductive reds : conf -> conf -> Prop :=
  | reds_here : forall c,
      term (fst c) ->
      reds c c
  | reds_step : forall c1 c2 c3,
      red c1 c2 ->
      reds c2 c3 ->
      reds c1 c3.

Definition terminal_conf (c:conf) : Prop :=
  value (fst c).

Definition reducible_conf (c:conf) : Prop :=
  exists c', c --> c'.

Definition safe_conf (c:conf) : Prop :=
  forall c', reds c c' -> terminal_conf c' \/ reducible_conf c'.

Definition typed_conf (c:conf) : Prop :=
  let '(t,mu) := c in
  exists Y T,
     empty ! Y |= t ~: T
  /\ Y |== mu.

Definition soundness : Prop :=
  forall c, typed_conf c -> safe_conf c.

(* ============ de Bruijn closedness of terms ============ *)

Fixpoint bclosed_rec (k:nat) (t:trm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | trm_bvar i     => i < k
  | trm_fvar _     => True
  | trm_abs t1     => bclosed_rec (S k) t1
  | trm_app t1 t2  => bclosed_rec k t1 /\ bclosed_rec k t2
  | trm_unit       => True
  | trm_int _      => True
  | trm_loc _      => True
  | trm_ref t1     => bclosed_rec k t1
  | trm_get t1     => bclosed_rec k t1
  | trm_set t1 t2  => bclosed_rec k t1 /\ bclosed_rec k t2
  | trm_rand t1    => bclosed_rec k t1
  end.

Definition closed_trm (t:trm) : Prop := forall j v, open_rec j v t = t.

Lemma open_bclosed_iff : forall t k x,
  bclosed_rec k (open_rec k (trm_fvar x) t) <-> bclosed_rec (S k) t.
Proof.
  induction t; intros k x; simpl.
  - case_if.
    + simpl. split; intros; auto with arith.
    + simpl. split; intros H; lia.
  - tauto.
  - simpl. apply IHt.
  - split; intro H; destruct H as [H1 H2]; split;
      [ apply (proj1 (IHt1 k x)) | apply (proj1 (IHt2 k x)) | apply (proj2 (IHt1 k x)) | apply (proj2 (IHt2 k x)) ]; assumption.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - simpl. apply IHt.
  - simpl. apply IHt.
  - split; intro H; destruct H as [H1 H2]; split;
      [ apply (proj1 (IHt1 k x)) | apply (proj1 (IHt2 k x)) | apply (proj2 (IHt1 k x)) | apply (proj2 (IHt2 k x)) ]; assumption.
  - simpl. apply IHt.
Qed.

Lemma term_bclosed : forall t, term t -> bclosed_rec 0 t.
Proof.
  intros t H. induction H.
  - simpl. tauto.
  - simpl. apply (proj1 (open_bclosed_iff t1 0 (var_gen L))).
    apply H0. apply var_gen_spec.
  - simpl. split; assumption.
  - simpl. tauto.
  - simpl. tauto.
  - simpl. tauto.
  - simpl. assumption.
  - simpl. assumption.
  - simpl. split; assumption.
  - simpl. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma term_closed : forall t, term t -> closed_trm t.
Proof.

  - split in Hb. rewrite IHt1; [rewrite IHt2| |]; try lia; try apply Hb; tauto.
Qed.
EOF

`Task.v` now contains the original definitions untouched, plus a library of helper lemmas and the completed proof of the target.

- **de Bruijn machinery**: a `bclosed_rec`/`closed_trm` notion, `open_bclosed_iff`, `term_bclosed`, `open_rec_bclosed`, and `term_closed`, needed because the typing rule for abstraction exposes the body opened with a *variable* while the operational rules use opening with a *term*.

by `cofix`, destructing the term and inverting the typing derivation, with one constructor of `coomnibig` chosen per operational case (including the step rules for subterm evaluation).
